clue.text: Eventual outcome produced by aiming too high?

definitions.meaning: first meaning: the final result of something
second meaning, read playfully: a shot fired upwards, over its target

explanation.walkthrough: The question mark flags the whimsical second reading, splitting the word into two parts: a shot that goes up.
explanation.definitionFit: An upshot is the final result or conclusion of a sequence of events.

clue.text: Soul of wit exemplified in single craft

parts.note: single means one
a liner is a large ship, a craft

explanation.surface: Wit personified by somebody alone in a boat.
explanation.walkthrough: Shakespeare's Polonius says brevity is the soul of wit; the answer is brevity in joke form.
explanation.definitionFit: A one-liner is a short quip, a perfect example of the brevity that Hamlet's Polonius calls the soul of wit.

clue.text: Adherent of widespread religious belief

parts.note: surface reading: a follower of a faith held by many people
setter's reading: the belief is spread across many gods rather than one

explanation.surface: Someone who follows a popular faith.
explanation.walkthrough: Widespread suggests a religion with many followers; it really means a belief spread over many deities.
explanation.definitionFit: A believer in many gods holds a faith whose divinity is spread across a whole pantheon.

clue.text: Computer device produced by firm with organised effort

parts.note: firm and hard are synonyms
a drive is a campaign, an organised effort

explanation.surface: A gadget made by a company through a concerted push.
explanation.walkthrough: Firm looks like a noun meaning a company; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: A hard drive is the disk storage unit inside a computer.

clue.text: Hazard at sea — do something to reduce canvas

definitions.meaning: first meaning: a ridge of rock or coral near the surface
second meaning: to take in part of a sail

explanation.walkthrough: Canvas here is sail-cloth, not a painting.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both an underwater ridge that wrecks ships and the sailor's action of rolling in sail to cut its area.

clue.text: Boy present for a musical performance

parts.note: a son is a boy
present, as in at the scene
taken as written

explanation.surface: A gift bought for a lad to enjoy a concert.
explanation.walkthrough: Present looks like a gift; it means being there, at.
explanation.definitionFit: A sonata is an instrumental composition, here standing for its playing at a recital.

clue.text: Provokes strike initially uncalled for

parts.note: to needle someone is to provoke them

indicators.note: initially points to the opening letter of the word it follows

parts.note: the first letter of strike

explanation.surface: A pointless walkout triggered by agitators.
explanation.definitionFit: Something needless is unnecessary, just as an uncalled-for remark serves no purpose.

clue.text: She opened the box containing one or two of Pa's pieces

indicators.note: containing says one piece holds another inside it

parts.note: the two letters of Pa, split apart to hold something
and/or: either one or both of two options

explanation.surface: A woman unwrapping a parcel holding some of Dad's belongings.
explanation.walkthrough: One or two reads as a vague quantity; it is the phrase and/or, meaning one or the other or both.
explanation.definitionFit: In Greek myth Pandora opened the forbidden jar or box, releasing evils into the world.

clue.text: Placed above leaders of all the other people

indicators.note: leaders are those at the front, so take the opening letter of each word

parts.note: the opening letters of these four words

explanation.surface: Put above everyone else's bosses.
explanation.definitionFit: Atop means on the top of, the position of something set over another thing.

clue.text: Workers taken back into excellent plant

indicators.note: into says one piece goes inside another

parts.note: A1, spelt A ONE, means first-rate

indicators.note: taken back means turned the other way round, read right to left

parts.note: men are workers on a site

explanation.surface: Staff re-employed in a fine factory.
explanation.walkthrough: Plant suggests a factory; it is the flower.
explanation.definitionFit: The anemone is a flowering plant of the buttercup family.

clue.text: Source of pictures showing shrub in front of golf club

parts.note: holly is an evergreen shrub
a wood is a type of golf club

explanation.surface: Photos of a bush beside a golf clubhouse.
explanation.walkthrough: Pictures means films, not photographs.
explanation.definitionFit: Hollywood is the Los Angeles district at the heart of the American film industry, which produces motion pictures.

clue.text: Fake psychoanalyst having change of heart

indicators.note: a change of heart means the central letter is swapped for another

parts.note: Sigmund Freud, founder of psychoanalysis

explanation.surface: A sham therapist who has altered his opinions.
explanation.walkthrough: The middle E of the name becomes A.
explanation.definitionFit: A fake is an impostor or sham, the same as a fraud.

clue.text: Fish producing bad smell when head's cut off

indicators.note: losing its head means the opening letter is removed

parts.note: a stench is a foul odour

explanation.surface: A beheaded fish starts to reek.
explanation.definitionFit: The tench is a freshwater fish of the carp family.

clue.text: Otherwise express runs to European country

parts.note: R is the cricket abbreviation for runs
E abbreviates European
a state is a country

explanation.surface: A fast train heading to somewhere on the Continent.
explanation.walkthrough: Express looks like a train; it is the verb to say.
explanation.definitionFit: To restate is to say something again in other words, expressing it otherwise.

clue.text: Stone cut, formally approved, and arranged in layers

parts.note: stone shortened to its abbreviation, the British weight unit of 14 pounds
to ratify is to give formal approval

explanation.surface: Cut stone, officially passed and laid in courses.
explanation.walkthrough: Cut tells you to abbreviate stone; a stone is a British unit of body weight.
explanation.definitionFit: Stratified rock or society is divided into strata, horizontal levels one above another.

clue.text: Playwright grasping man who acts badly is obstacle

parts.note: J. M. Barrie, author of Peter Pan
a cad is a man who behaves dishonourably

explanation.surface: A dramatist clutching a poor actor causes a hindrance.
explanation.walkthrough: A man who acts badly sounds like a ham actor; it is a scoundrel.
explanation.definitionFit: A barricade is a barrier set up to block passage, an obstacle.

clue.text: Justice and three others using bad advice run trials

indicators.note: bad advice is faulty, so its letters with those following are in the wrong order

parts.note: fifteen letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: The courts holding trials on misguided legal counsel.
explanation.walkthrough: Justice suggests a courtroom; it is one of four classical virtues.
explanation.definitionFit: The four cardinal virtues are prudence, justice, temperance and fortitude, so justice plus three others completes the set.

clue.text: A cop went crazy in African city

indicators.note: crazy suggests disorder, so the letters are jumbled

parts.note: eight letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: A police officer lost his mind somewhere in Africa.
explanation.definitionFit: Cape Town is a major South African city and the country's legislative capital.

clue.text: As usual, Ben messed up, not fit to be employed

indicators.note: something messed up is disordered, so these letters are scrambled

parts.note: eight letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Ben has botched things again and is now unemployable.
explanation.walkthrough: As usual reads as a phrase, but As is only the link; the fodder starts at usual.
explanation.definitionFit: Unusable means unable to be used, and employed here carries its sense of put to use.

clue.text: Setter's superior when it comes to giving directions in clue

definitions.text: Setter's superior when it comes to giving directions
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a gundog that indicates game by aiming its nose, better at that than a setter
second meaning: a hint or tip

explanation.walkthrough: Setter seems to be the crossword compiler; it is a gundog, a breed related to the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names a dog breed that stands rigid to show where game lies, and a helpful hint.

clue.text: Reduced access for French artist

indicators.note: reduced means made shorter, so the final letter goes

parts.note: ingress is a way in, access

explanation.surface: Limited entry granted to a painter from France.
explanation.definitionFit: Jean-Auguste-Dominique Ingres was a nineteenth-century French Neoclassical painter.

clue.text: One in suit given precedence over others? Blast!

definitions.text: One in suit given precedence over others
definitions.meaning: first meaning: a card of the suit ranking above all others in a hand
second meaning: a blare, as of a trumpet

explanation.walkthrough: Suit suggests clothes or a lawsuit; it is a suit of cards.
explanation.definitionFit: The word means both a card of the ruling suit and, archaically, a trumpet blast.

clue.text: Effective drink for party on Fourth of July

parts.note: punch is a mixed drink served at parties

indicators.note: fourth of points to the letter in fourth position of the word that follows

parts.note: the fourth letter of July

explanation.surface: A potent cocktail for an Independence Day celebration.
explanation.walkthrough: Fourth of July looks like the US holiday; it is one letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Punchy writing or play is forceful and effective, packing a punch.

clue.text: Fail to notice single person? Not he

definitions.meaning: second meaning: a young unmarried woman

explanation.walkthrough: Not he narrows the single person to a woman.
explanation.definitionFit: The word is both the verb for overlooking something and the title of an unmarried woman.

clue.text: Fierce individual having row, good at heart

indicators.note: at heart means sitting in the middle of something

parts.note: a tier is a row of seats
G abbreviates good

explanation.surface: An aggressive person in an argument who is decent deep down.
explanation.walkthrough: Row looks like a quarrel; it is a line of seats.
explanation.definitionFit: A tiger is used figuratively for a fierce, aggressive person.

clue.text: Short river, hardly stream

parts.note: R is the short form of river
ill means hardly, as in can ill afford

explanation.surface: A brief river that barely counts as a stream.
explanation.definitionFit: A rill is a small brook or rivulet.

clue.text: Leading man's changing it, if he can

indicators.note: changing signals that the letters following are rearranged

parts.note: nine letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: An actor in the lead role will alter his part where possible.
explanation.walkthrough: Leading man suggests a star actor; it is a head of a clan.
explanation.definitionFit: A chieftain is the leader of a tribe or clan, literally a man who leads.

clue.text: Nasty type we had put outside quickly turned around

indicators.note: put outside means wrapped around another piece

parts.note: we'd is the contraction of we had
a heel is a contemptible person

explanation.surface: We threw out an unpleasant character, who spun round fast.
explanation.walkthrough: Turned around looks like a reversal signal; it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: To wheel is to turn sharply on the spot, so wheeled means swung round quickly.

clue.text: Secretive activity, the last resort?

indicators.note: resort, read as re-sort, means sort again into a new order

parts.note: seven letters to rearrange

explanation.surface: Covert action as a final fallback.
explanation.walkthrough: Last resort reads as a fixed phrase, but resort splits off as re-sort.
explanation.definitionFit: Stealth is acting quietly and covertly so as not to be noticed.
